title: Dead Sea Scrolls Isaiah matches text a thousand years later

tellings.quote: Wes Huff when he was on my podcast explained to me that the book of Isaiah that they found in the Dead Sea Scrolls is verbatim the same as the book of Isaiah that was a thousand years more recent.

plain: The copy of the Book of Isaiah found among the Dead Sea Scrolls, ancient manuscripts discovered near Qumran by the Dead Sea, is word for word the same as a version copied a thousand years later, according to the podcaster Joe Rogan. Rogan tells Michels he heard this from a guest on his own show, Wes Huff, and brings it up as a sign that old texts can be passed down for centuries without changing.
